The Account Manager is responsible for building and maintaining strong, long-term client relationships while actively driving business growth. Beyond managing existing accounts, the role places a strong emphasis on proactive client development, including prospection within the existing portfolio, cross-selling, and identifying new revenue opportunities. The Account Manager acts as both a trusted advisor and a commercial driver, combining relationship management with strong sales, negotiation, and business development skills.
 

 
• Develop and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with assigned clients.
 
• Ensure timely and successful delivery of solutions according to client needs and objectives, and this is within the existing HighCo DATA services package.
 
• Conduct regular business reviews with clients to assess performance and identify opportunities. 

 
• Strong sales and negotiation skills
 
• Excellent interpersonal and communication abilities in French, Dutch and English
 
• Customer-centric mindset with strong business acumen
 
• Ability to identify and convert opportunities into revenue
 
• Proactive and results-oriented approach
 
• Strong organizational and time management skills
 
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
 
• Team collaboration and cross-functional coordination
 
• Highly driven with a strong commercial mindset
 
• Results-oriented with a focus on growth and performance

We are currently looking for a Receptionist for a temporary replacement to join a lovely international company located near Avenue Louise in Brussels.
 

As the first point of contact for visitors and colleagues, you will play an important role in ensuring a warm welcome and the smooth day-to-day running of the office. You will work in a pleasant, professional and English-speaking environment.
 

Your responsibilities
 

Welcome visitors and ensure a professional and friendly reception.
 

Answer incoming calls and handle general enquiries.
 

Manage incoming and outgoing mail and deliveries.
 

Coordinate meeting rooms and assist with appointments.
 

Provide general administrative support to the team.
 

Help maintain an organised and welcoming office environment.

You have previous experience in reception, front-office or administrative support.
 

You are fluent in English; knowledge of French and/or Dutch is an asset.
 

You have excellent communication and organisational skills.
 

You are service-oriented, proactive and flexible.
 

You are comfortable working in an international environment and handling several tasks simultaneously.
 

You are available for a temporary replacement.

As Warehouse Operator, you will execute in an accurate manner tasks concerning both the physical handling and administration aspect of goods that are received, stocked, delivered to internal customers and shipped to external contacts.

The assignment

• Make sure that goods are stored and registered in the appropriate location
• Stock counts
• Check stock of standard goods in the cleanroom and ensure sufficient and timely supply within shelf life and register accordingly
• Deliver goods to cleanroom upon request of internal customers and register accordingly
• Receive goods from internal customers, pack, label and ship to external location taking into account applicable legislation

• You work efficiently, accurately and neatly and have an eye for safety.
• You are energetic, not afraid of physical work and have a great sense of responsibility.
• Your team spirit guarantees a flexible working arrangement.
• You are fluent in Dutch and have a good knowledge of English.
• A certificate for operation of an electric stacker and forklift driving license is a plus.
• You preferably have several years of experience in administrative processing, experience with SAP is a plus.

Do you also love fries and are looking for a new challenge? Our client is a leading player in the production and development of potato-based delicacies. Due to further growth of the Wielsbeke site, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician in 2 shifts. As a preventive maintenance technician, you are passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. Your goal? Ensure smooth operation and minimise downtime.
 
 
 
• Be an example in adhering to prescribed guidelines and procedures for a (food) safe, environmentally conscious, and orderly working environment. 
 
• As a technician, you recognise potential problems before they cause breakdowns. You report these findings accurately, allowing us to act proactively and minimise unplanned downtime. 
 
• You perform scheduled maintenance tasks, such as inspections, lubrications, adjustments and replacements. 
 
• You work closely with our operational teams and your technical colleagues to optimise the maintenance plan. 
 
• You provide external employees with the necessary support and follow-up to make their contribution effective and efficient. You also supervise technical trainees and new employees to help them grow in their roles. 
 
• You keep accurate records of maintenance work carried out, using the maintenance software (Ultimo). 

 
 
• You have a technical education or equivalent experience 
 
• You have several years of experience as a technician and a passion for technology 
 
• You have knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems 
 
• You have a proactive attitude 
 
• You have logical insight and good problem-solving skills, allowing you to work independently 
 
• You are a team player who contributes to smooth communication and joint success 
 
• You speak Dutch or French or English and are willing to understand other language colleagues 
 
• You are willing to work in a 2-shift regime

Our client is an international animal health organization operating in a dynamic and fast-growing environment. The company combines global expertise with local market impact and offers employees the opportunity to influence business development within a specialized sector.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Veterinary Services Manager Poultry - Benelux, you will have the following responsibilities:

• Provide technical and scientific support to poultry customers (farmers, veterinary clinics & veterinarians) and partners.
• Build and maintain relationships with veterinarians, farmers, and key stakeholders.
• Act as the poultry technical expert for the Benelux market.
• Support commercial teams with technical product knowledge and customer insights.
• Deliver training sessions to customers, veterinarians, and internal teams.
• Develop and maintain a strong network of Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
• Support product launches and market development initiatives.
• Analyze field data and provide solutions to customer challenges.

As a successful Veterinary Services Manager Poultry - Benelux, you will have the following profile:

• Degree in Veterinary Medicine preferred; strong poultry expertise is essential.
• Experience in poultry production, veterinary practice, or animal health.
• Strong technical affinity and willingness to learn.
• Commercial mindset
• Hands-on, proactive, and adaptable mindset.
• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
• Fluent Dutch and English; French is a strong asset.
• Comfortable with regular travel across the Benelux region and occasional European meetings.

Are you fluent in three languages, passionate about customer interaction and committed to delivering excellent service?

Take on a Customer Service role within the banking and insurance sector in Brussels. This is a great opportunity to put your French, Dutch and English language skills into practice while using your communication and problem-solving abilities in a professional environment.

 

Your responsibilities

As a Customer Service representative, you will:

• Handle customer enquiries by phone and email in French, Dutch and English.
• Provide information and guide customers through their requests.
• Follow up on customer cases and administrative matters.
• Identify suitable solutions to meet customer needs.
• Deliver efficient, professional and high-quality customer support.

About you : 

• You hold a bachelor's or master's degree. 
• You are fluent in French, Dutch and English, both spoken and written.
• You have excellent communication skills.
• You enjoy customer interaction and providing support.
• You are organised, accurate and solution-oriented.
• You are comfortable using IT tools and systems.
• You can work independently while contributing effectively to a team.

Mechnical Design Engineer (R&D Professional) 
 

Company
 

Xeikon is a world-leading innovator in digital printing, focusing on labels and packaging, commercial print, and related applications. Operating in an industrial capital goods environment, Xeikon designs, develops, manufactures and markets high-quality digital colour printers and presses.
 

Xeikon is part of Flint Group. Its pioneering products and services form the foundation of Flint Group Digital Printing Solutions. This division broadens Flint Group’s portfolio of conventional and digital printing solutions, offering a unique combination of equipment, consumables and services to customers worldwide.
 

 
 

Mission
 

As a member of the 
R&D Electromechanical Design team, you will contribute directly to the development of next-generation digital printing engines. You will take responsibility for mechanical designs that translate innovative ideas into reliable, industrial-grade products.
 

 
 

Main Responsibilities (see attachement for all details)

Profile
 

· You hold a 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in (electro)mechanical engineering or industrial design.
 

· You have 
3–5 years of experience in mechanical design within an industrial or high-tech environment.
 

· You have solid knowledge of 
manufacturing techniques, such as machining, sheet metal, injection moulding, extrusion and 3D printing, including their capabilities and limitations.
 

· You have experience with 
3D CAD software, preferably 
PTC Creo.
 

· You have a strong understanding of 
mechanical physics.
 

· You are a 
hands-on team player with good communication skills in 
Dutch and English.
 

· You are analytical, solution-oriented and able to work independently.
 

· You are eager to learn, resilient under pressure and motivated by technical challenges.

R&D Project Manager Inkjet
 

Flint Group Digital Xeikon 
 | 
 Lier, Belgium 
 | 
 Full-time
 

Lead industrial inkjet development from business case to market introduction, bringing multidisciplinary teams together to turn customer needs into production-ready printing solutions.
 

About Flint Group Digital Xeikon and the role
 

Flint Group Digital Xeikon, part of Flint Group, develops digital printing solutions for labels and packaging. As R&D Project Manager, you will lead projects across our inkjet portfolio, including Panther UV inkjet label presses and IDERA aqueous inkjet solutions for corrugated applications.
 

Reporting to the Director Inkjet & Program Management, you will guide development, validation, industrialisation and launch, leading cross-functional teams through collaboration and influence.
 

What you will do
 

--> see attachement
 

What you bring
 

• 
 A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, applied science or technology, or equivalent relevant experience.
 

• 
 At least five years of project management experience in complex industrial product development, including work with external suppliers or development partners.
 

• 
 Strong planning, budget and risk management skills, with experience of validation, industrialisation and structured project reviews.
 

• 
 The technical judgement to work across disciplines, communicate clearly and align stakeholders without formal authority.
 

• 
 Professional proficiency in English and willingness to travel internationally when projects require it. Dutch or other languages are an advantage.
 

Industrial inkjet, digital printing, capital equipment or hardware/software development experience is an advantage. Project management certification is welcome but not essential.
 

Why join us
 

Own technically challenging projects with a direct impact on Flint Group Digital Xeikon’s global inkjet portfolio. Collaborate with engineering specialists and international partners, and help improve how we develop and deliver products. Hybrid working is available in line with company policy. We offer a salary package with fringe benefits in line with the market.
 

Interested
 

Apply with your CV and a short introduction highlighting your experience in industrial product development and project delivery.
 

HR: bart.stalmans@flintgrp.com
 

Hiring Manager: stijn.debeugher@flintgrp.com

For our sister company FARO INSIGHT in Belgium, we are seeking a Dutch-speaking Sales Development Representative.
 

Key Responsibilities:
 
 

• Collaborate closely with multiple Account Managers to drive revenue growth through outbound prospecting 

• Qualify leads and prospects using a solution-based discovery approach (understanding customer workflows, pain points and desired outcome) 

• Manage prospects from initial lead generation through to the demo stage, showcasing the value proposition, navigating objections, and fostering meaningful relationships 

• Drive pipeline growth through a combination of outbound prospecting (calls, email, social media) and inbound lead follow-up 

• Schedule and coordinate product demonstrations in collaboration with Account Managers 

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Salesforce (leads, contacts, opportunities)

Education, Experience & Skills:
 
 

• Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, Communications or related field, and proven sales or business development experience or equivalent work experience

• Minimum 2-3 years of relevant experience in business development or B2B sales  including lead generation and cold calling within an international company 

• Experience in technology sales focusing on top of funnel 

• Experience in manufacturing and/or high-tech industries is a strong advantage 

• Hands-on experience Salesforce CRM, Sales Engagement (or other cadencing tool), LinkedIn, and 6Sense (or other account intelligence platform).

Additional requirements:
 
 

• Strong hunter mentality with the ability to identify and overcome barriers while achieving goals 

• Self-starter with ability to work both independently and collaboratively within an international team environment 

• Proactive, solution-oriented, and adaptable approach   

• Structured, resilient, and process-driven working style 

• Adaptability to changing priorities in a dynamic environment  

• Enthusiasm for high-tech products and ability to communicate their value effectively to customers 

• Positive, energetic personality with strong team spirit

jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working in a welcoming retail environment and love the magic of Christmas? Do you enjoy helping customers find the perfect decorations for the holiday season?

For a unique Christmas store in the heart of Bruges, we are looking for an enthusiastic Store Assistant / Sales Associate who will help customers bring the Christmas spirit into their homes.

What will you do?As a Sales Associate, you will be the face of the store and ensure that every customer enjoys a warm and pleasant shopping experience.

Your responsibilities include:

• Welcoming and assisting customers in a friendly manner
• Advising customers on Christmas decorations, ornaments, gifts and seasonal products
• Maintaining an attractive and organized store presentation
• Restocking shelves and keeping the store clean and tidy
• Processing payments and handling cash register duties
• Assisting with deliveries and unpacking new merchandise

• You enjoy working with customers and providing excellent service
• You are willing to work weekends on a rotating schedule
• Previous retail or sales experience is an advantage
• You speak Spanish, Dutch or English fluently
• In addition to your strongest language, you can communicate at a basic level in at least one of the other languages
• You enjoy working in an international environment with tourists and visitors from different countries
• You are enthusiastic, reliable and enjoy working as part of a team

• Reliable address, building and network data for a fibre-to-the-home network in Wallonia is your core responsibility: you process and resolve address requests across DMP, Cocon, the address lists and the build lists, and keep one consistent view of every address.
• Each Deployment Area’s build list is yours to create and re-challenge, from the address sources to the list locked with the operators.
• Before each submission to the operators, you run data-quality checks, correct errors at the source and keep the deviation per area below the contractual limit. In addition, you build the poles database and reconcile it with ORES and RESA.
• The MDU register stays complete under your care, and you flag streets at risk of capacity shortage while re-blowing fibre is still an option.
• As part of the design process, you contribute to the pre-design package and to the address and connectivity checks of the design review.
• Using SQL, Python, FME and QGIS, you build validation rules and scripts, with AI-assisted tooling where it speeds up the work.
• Coordination with Build, Operations, the operators and the partners is part of the job, as are occasional site visits with construction partners or survey teams. Clear documentation of your work ensures that others can reproduce it.

Desired profile
•  +-5 years of experience in data analysis, data quality, data engineering or geodata, with a domain owned end to end
• Experience with geospatial data: coordinate systems and spatial joins, address and geometry data, QGIS or a comparable tool
• Experience running, tracing and modifying existing ETL workflows in FME or a comparable tool
• The following are an asset:
• hands-on FME, PyQGIS or QGIS plugin development
• knowledge of Belgian address and cadastral references: BeST Address/CRAB, ICAR, PICC, SPW and Belmap
• FTTH or telecom knowledge, such as poles, coverage and network inventories like Cocon
• experience with recurring regulatory or compliance reporting💡 Your skills
• SQL skills, including queries, joins and reconciliations across systems.
• You use Python for data work (pandas or equivalent), scripting and automation, and you can read and modify existing scripts.
• Demonstrable data-quality rigour: validation, reconciliation, deduplication and error tracing.
• Recurring manual work is something you turn into repeatable checks and scripts.
• You know how AI-assisted tools on real data or scripting work, verify the output and remain accountable for it.
• Knowledge of Power BI or Microsoft Fabric, or experience building small internal tools for non-technical colleagues, is a plus.
• You speak French fluently and have a professional knowledge of English. Dutch is an asset.🌟 Who are you?
•     You are meticulous with address and geometry data, because you know a bad join can spread into build lists and regulatory figures.

•     You are autonomous: you run the queue, resolve most cases alone and know what to escalate.

•     You work through a large queue steadily and triage by impact.

•     You document and share your work so that colleagues can reuse it.

Are you an accurate and well-organized administrative professional who enjoys following up on actions and keeping documentation in order? As our Compliance & Safety Department Assistant, you will support NHV’s Compliance Monitoring Manager and Safety Manager at our headquarters in Ostend.

You will perform a broad range of preparation, administrative and follow-up activities within our Compliance and Safety Department. Your work will help ensure that findings, safety recommendations, action plans, meeting minutes, registers and other documents remain complete, accurate and up to date.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• 
Preparing audit documentation, reports, correspondence and supporting information.

• 
Registering and following up on audit findings, non-compliances, corrective actions and deadlines.

• 
Monitoring safety recommendations and ensuring that actions and extension requests are followed up on time.

• 
Collecting information for monthly compliance and safety reports.

• 
Supporting the preparation and publication of QHSSE and HSEQ plans.

• 
Gathering Safety Performance Indicator data and supporting safety reporting for customers.

• 
Assisting with the administration of authorisations, stamps and engineer files.

• 
Keeping Management of Change and Emergency Response Plan documentation current.

• 
Preparing meeting minutes and following up on open action points.

• 
Collecting content for the monthly Safety Newsletter.

• 
Supporting the Compliance Monitoring Manager and Safety Manager with departmental projects.

You will work with systems such as IQM, Fleetplan, SharePoint and Rusada. Once you have gained sufficient experience, the role may be further developed to include responsibilities as a part-time auditor.

We are looking for a reliable and proactive colleague who combines strong administrative skills with accuracy, discretion and a practical approach.

You preferably have:

• 
A secondary education qualification. A relevant bachelor’s degree is an advantage.

• 
Previous administrative experience. Experience within quality, compliance or safety administration is an asset.

• 
Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.

• 
Experience with SharePoint or similar document management systems.

• 
Excellent organizational and planning skills.

• 
The ability to work accurately with detailed and confidential information.

• 
A professional and assertive communication style, enabling you to follow up on actions and deadlines in a firm but respectful manner.

• 
A flexible, hands-on approach and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

• 
Fluent English, both written and spoken.

• 
Knowledge of Dutch and/or French is an advantage.

An aviation background is not required, as NHV will provide on-the-job training. Knowledge of EASA regulations, including Air Operations, Part-145, Part-147 or CAMO, is considered an advantage.
